description: Read messages of a channel or thread (newest last). Use before/after to page. Embeds are shortened unless full is true.

bot.description: Use this bot (name or id) instead of choosing automatically

channel.description: Channel or thread name, id, or message link

full.description: Show embeds in full: every field's text, colours, footer, author, images and link buttons (to read a post completely or copy its design)

server.description: Server name or id. Optional when the bot is in one server or DISCORD_GUILD_ID is set.

name: read_messages
